cohort: Pregnant women (n = 1470) in a South Indian City who underwent an Oral Glucose Tolerance Test between 24 and 36 weeks of gestation.
finding: The impact of maternal glucose levels on infant and maternal outcomes notably differed by sex, with male infants showing a stronger association with higher infant weight and increased skinfold thickness compared to female infants.
mod_finding: The odds of delivering via caesarean section were 45% higher for every one standard deviation increase in 2-hour post-load glucose in women carrying a female fetus.
